summary_1line: Ravana visits the ascetic demon Maricha and reveals his plan to abduct Sita by using Maricha disguised as a golden deer to lure Rama away.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands before the ascetic Maricha in a lonely forest hermitage, outlining his scheme while the demon listens in growing terror.
Ravana describes the magical plan of a golden deer flecked with silver wandering before Rama’s forest hut to entice Sita.
Maricha, pale and trembling with dry lips and folded hands, stares at Ravana in dread upon hearing Sita’s name and the plan.
